authority: User HUMAN DECISION — M4 R1 / R2 CANONICAL CLOSURE, 2026-09-23

en-US.setup: Wear the paddle on one hand using the black strap on its red back.
en-US.catch: Catch by letting the ball stick to the blue front of the paddle.
en-US.reset: Take the ball off with your free hand. Use your free hand for the next toss.
en-US.boundary: The paddle has no handle. Do not put body weight on a paddle-strapped hand on the ground.
en-US.arc: A high arc describes the ball’s path, not a face or head target. The catch target is the paddle.

tr.setup: Paddle’ı kırmızı arkasındaki siyah el kayışıyla bir eline tak.
tr.catch: Topu paddle’ın mavi ön yüzüne yapıştırarak yakala.
tr.reset: Topu boş elinle ayır. Sonraki atışı boş elinle yap.
tr.boundary: Paddle’ın sapı yoktur. Paddle takılı elinle yere basıp vücut ağırlığını taşıma.
tr.arc: Yüksek yay, topun uçuş yolunu anlatır; yüz veya baş hedef değildir. Yakalama hedefi paddle’dır.

rendering: Shared content, not permission to add screens or mandatory onboarding. Mission-specific timing still applies, e.g. m05 freeze precedes reset.
success: All goals are physical-play goals; the app does not observe or infer completion.

missionTimingNotes.m04: The hand holding the detached ball becomes the free hand after the approved strap transfer. Detach still precedes transfer; toss is still free-hand. No ball remains attached during strap change.
missionTimingNotes.m17: Counted pose/toss/catch and normal return pass are different phases. Return pass does not advance leader count.
missionTimingNotes.m27: Signal uses paddle while detached ball stays in free hand; receiving blue-front orientation is re-established for each catch.
